activity_summary: At Old Swan Stairs Davy Gannet had Raleigh home from Plymouth in a ship so deep in gold she would hardly steer. He had told you the first half in February and kept the second ready. You asked how many men off the ship he had spoken with. He had it from a lighter. George Bryan would not buy the gold. You said you would keep the smaller tale if Paul's had one.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the landing, and refused the gold.

entities.name: Davy Gannet
entities.context: Brought the ship home at full size, from a lighter, and said it would hold fair.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Held the boat, and walked up without the gold.

entities.name: Raleigh
entities.context: Mentioned in A ship too deep to steer

facets.activity: Heard Gannet on Raleigh's gold ship

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: Raleigh's home! Landed at Plymouth with a ship so deep in gold she'd hardly steer.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: You told me in February he was gone for gold.

quotes.speaker: davy_gannet
quotes.text: I have spoken with a man who had it from a lighter.
